# Test that ratchet handles command failures gracefully

# Initialize git repo
exec git init
exec git config user.name "Test User"
exec git config user.email "test@example.com"

# Create a branch with some content
exec git checkout -b main
exec git add file.txt
exec git commit -m 'initial commit'

# Create feature branch with a change
exec git checkout -b feature
cp file-changed.txt file.txt
exec git add file.txt
exec git commit -m 'feature change'

# Test with a command that fails
! exec ratchet --lt main 'nonexistent-command'
stderr 'command failed'

# Test with a command that succeeds but returns non-numeric output
! exec ratchet --lt main 'echo "not a number"'
stderr 'no numeric value found'

-- file.txt --
Some content here
-- file-changed.txt --
Some different content here
